result.reverse_note: Raw CSV column names preserved in data/raw; mapping applied only to interim/processed
result.vendor_history_method: Expanding, one-row-shifted statistics within training data; validation and test use the training-period aggregates only.
result.prediction_moment: After shipment attributes and scheduled delivery date are known, before actual delivery outcome is observed.

inventory.training_recommendation: An experimental proxy classifier can be trained only after excluding Opening_Stock and Line_Item_Quantity, which exactly define the flag. The augmented inventory source remains unverified; retain the rule audit and do not present proxy metrics as operational validation.

result.prediction_moment: Before delivery outcome; uses scheduled date calendar + order/vendor attrs
result.proposal_comparison: xgboost vs logistic_regression (baseline); random_forest is an extra comparison

post_2010_training_sensitivity.threshold_source: full-training validation split; not retuned on test

calibration.note: Validation late rate differs from test (prior shift); use recalibrate_late_model() on recent delivered outcomes to refresh calibration and threshold as conditions drift.

result.note: PO-to-client delivery duration — not generic supplier procurement lead time
Volume series is shipment/order quantity proxy, not verified warehouse demand.

late_rate_monthly.rationale: Monthly history is too short or irregular; prefer classical baselines.

volume_monthly.rationale: Monthly history is too short or irregular; prefer classical baselines.

late_rate_monthly.selection_method: rolling-origin over validation period (1 refits, step 3); baseline preferred within 2%
late_rate_monthly.test_result_note: Selected with validation data only; test comparison is a final holdout diagnostic.

volume_monthly.selection_method: rolling-origin over validation period (1 refits, step 3); baseline preferred within 2%
volume_monthly.test_result_note: Selected with validation data only; test comparison is a final holdout diagnostic.

lstm.reason: Classical monthly lag models are compared with explicit baselines; no neural model is justified without a demonstrated validation gain.

result.caveat: Vendors with fewer than 10 shipments and dominant vendors are separated from KMeans. Segments describe operating profiles, not vendor quality.

injected_disruption_check.label: SYNTHETIC - evaluation only, never written to the scores table

vendor_kpi.missing_kpi: defect rate (not present in SCMS data)

result.label: unusual_shipment_profile
result.note: vendor_kpi flags unusual supplier performance periods (proposal model). Shipment-level scores indicate unusual numeric profiles; they are not delay predictors. Retrospective includes outcome data and is forensic only.

result.experimental_warning: The label is a deterministic function of excluded opening-stock and quantity fields. This model uses other attributes as an exploratory proxy; source inventory provenance is unverified.

result.note: Synthetic fixtures, source-attributed official extracts, and user uploads; project reports and docs are excluded.

retrieval_evaluation.metrics: MRR and Recall@k over 20 questions with gold document+section labels

When must a vendor notify procurement about an expected delay?
Which mode should clinically urgent ARV shipments use?
What service credit applies for a late delivery?
What is the maximum penalty cap for repeated late weeks?
Which events are excluded from force majeure relief?
How long must shipment and delivery records be retained?
At what vendor late rate must procurement escalate?
How many shipments must a vendor quarter contain to be reviewed?
What must a disruption claim cite as evidence?
Below how many days of stock cover is it an inventory emergency?
When does a stockout occur?
What temperature range must cold chain products be kept in?
What happens after a temperature excursion longer than two hours?
What defect rate triggers a quality review?
Can a missing temperature record block batch release?
How quickly must a Severity 1 disruption be acknowledged?
What must an escalation record reference?
Are anomaly scores proof of fraud?
Must missing freight cost be treated as zero?

retrieval_evaluation.limitation: Corpus is small and synthetic; absolute scores indicate wiring and rank quality, not performance on real procurement documents.
